feeds.title: Veterinary Internal Medicine Nursing Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Laura. I'm a registered veterinary nurse who has a special passion for medical nursing. Through my blogs, I spend my time teaching other veterinary nurses by sharing hints, tips, educational content, and more. Veterinary Internal Medicine Nursing is a page dedicated to all things internal medicine.

feeds.title: Vets Now News
feeds.description: Our writers bring you insights into what it's like to be part of the Vets Now team. Read our employer brand news from the veterinary industry. We're proud to have helped revolutionize the provision of emergency veterinary care. We partner with local veterinary practices to provide their clients with a dedicated out-of-hours service.

feeds.title: Vetnurse.co.uk | Vet Nurse News
feeds.description: Our website shares veterinary nursing news for RVNs, QVNs, and veterinary nursing assistants. Vetnurse.co.uk is a community for veterinary nurses, assistants, and students.

feeds.title: Vet Nurse School Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Tess Nolan. Our blog shares a little bit of behind-the-scenes, educational, and information on important and relevant topics. The purpose of Vet Nurse School is to share & condense my knowledge, advice, and experiences in the Veterinary Industry, into short, fun, and easy-to-digest courses & online resources!

feeds.title: British Veterinary Nursing Association Blog
feeds.description: Our blog shares Veterinary Nursing Archives, informative articles and updates. The British Veterinary Nursing Association aims to promote animal health and welfare through the ongoing development of professional excellence in veterinary nursing.

feeds.title: Pet GP Blog
feeds.description: Our blog shares the latest industry news, resources, and stories about pet healthcare. PetGP was set up in 2003 as a new way for pet owners to get veterinary advice and peace of mind when they need it most. We're now the UK's largest, most trusted helpline, with highly-trained Vets and Vet Nurses across the UK, and we work with a number of the country's leading charities and insurers.

feeds.title: Vet Prac Blog
feeds.description: Vet Prac Blog keeps you up to date with the latest techniques and advances in veterinary science, as well as consistently honing your veterinary skills and knowledge. VetPrac courses are designed by vets for vets with the realities of practice in mind. Our workshops provide a nurturing environment in which to practice surgical skills without compromising patient health.

feeds.title: The College of Animal Welfare Blog
feeds.description: Our Blog shares the latest CAW news. The College of Animal Welfare was established in 1989, it is one of the UK's leading providers of Veterinary Nurse and Animal Care training and education. Our business school provides business-related courses to both those inside and outside of the animal profession.

feeds.title: Holistic Vet Nurse Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Lilo Ask-Henriksen . Check out our blog posts for holistic pet care tips, events, and stories for dog lovers in and around London, Chelsea, and Kings Road at Holistic Vet Nurse. We are dedicated to holistic health combined with her long experience and excellent nurturing and caring skills to get her patients back to their healthy equilibrium.

feeds.title: Veterinary Blog
feeds.description: I'm Sophie, a registered veterinary nurse. Here you will find veterinary professionals sharing their 'tails' of life at work or their experience with animals. The aim of the blog is to inform and inspire those already working within the veterinary sector and those thinking of it as a career.

feeds.title: ClinicWise Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Dr. Steve Merchant. Our blog shares informative articles on pet care. Virtual Vet Nurse is your digital assistant lives and works within your clinic's website. We bring ideas and cost-effective technologies to support veterinary teams.

feeds.title: Vet Times Blog » VN Blogs
feeds.description: This section of our blog features articles on Vet Nurse. Vet Times is the ultimate one-stop online resource for daily news and recruitment listings for UK veterinary professionals. It brings to you by Veterinary Business Development (VBD), the leading veterinary communications company.

feeds.title: Vets : Stay, Go, Diversify Blog
feeds.description: On our blog, we share a whole heap of articles written by us and our members sharing tips and advice on how to get the most out of your career and veterinary skillset. Vets: Stay, Go Diversify (VSGD) is an international community of veterinary professionals who support each other in pursuing fulfilling careers.
